response.overview: To add a room to an existing Carnival cruise booking, contact【 +1⇢888⇢315⇢9962 (US)】or【+1⇢888⇢315⇢9962 (UK)】【+1⇢888⇢315⇢9962 (US)】Carnival Cruises or your travel advisor and request an additional stateroom. The new room is subject to availability, sailing capacity, and the current fare. Ask the representative to review available cabins and connect the reservations when appropriate.
